scenario_name: 1 omitted dimensions; intended use: Spring section (Sezione primavera)
initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Schools and educational activities'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C')
  AND education >= 80.07
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
